create.name: Devin Hunter
create.bio:
Devin Hunter is a witch, psychic medium and author who has worked professionally with spirits and clients for more than two decades. He holds third-degree initiations in the Northern Star tradition of Wicca and in the Dianic tradition, founded his own path, the Sacred Fires tradition, and is one of the three founders of the Black Rose school, alongside Storm Faerywolf and Chas Bogan. He also hosts the long-running Modern Witch podcast, which has introduced many listeners to practical magic.

His books, published by Llewellyn, begin with a trilogy on personal power, spirit allies and the deeper mysteries of the Craft, then turn to hands-on spellcraft in Modern Witch, crystals in Crystal Magic for the Modern Witch, plant lore in Houseplant Hortocculture and, most recently, cleansing and psychic protection in The Bad Vibes Field Guide. Through Modern Witch University, the online school he runs with his collaborators, he teaches the thirteen-month Black Rose Witchcraft course, in which the three founders talk through each month's theme in recorded sessions, and he also works with a small number of private students. The school is based in Antioch, in the San Francisco Bay Area.

books.title: The Witch's Book of Power
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: His first book, on finding and building a witch's personal power by working with one's own energy, cosmic forces and spirit allies.

books.title: The Witch's Book of Spirits
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: A guide to ritual and relationship with the unseen: guides, familiars, angels, the dead, faeries and other spirits, and how a witch can work alongside them.

books.title: The Witch's Book of Mysteries
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: The third book in his Witch's Book series, drawing on his own book of shadows for deeper practices of self-orientation, inner sight and personal gnosis.

books.title: Modern Witch
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: A richly photographed collection of spells, charms, recipes and correspondences from his working grimoire, grouped by the main reasons people turn to magic.

books.title: Crystal Magic for the Modern Witch
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: A colour reference to more than a hundred stones and metals, with their correspondences, grids and spells for using them in magical practice.

books.title: Houseplant Hortocculture
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: Joins practical care of indoor plants with their occult lore, showing how to bring small magical acts into watering, potting and tending them.

books.title: The Bad Vibes Field Guide
books.author: Devin Hunter
books.description: His newest book, a step-by-step handbook on cleansing and shielding against unwanted energies and spirits, written for beginners and practising psychics alike.

courses.title: Black Rose Witchcraft
courses.description: A thirteen-month online course with weekly lessons in witchcraft, magic and spiritual practice, taken at your own pace. Each month opens with a recorded discussion of its theme by the school's three founders, of whom Devin Hunter is one.
courses.price: $35 a month for twelve months, or $350 single payment
